label: Version 1-1 — cream background trial
status: User-requested separate colour experiment; saved Version 1-1 remains unchanged
prompt:
Edit this exact cover by changing ONLY the colour of the continuous scrubbed wood background from pale green/sage to a warmer CREAM / IVORY colour throughout. Preserve the existing finely rubbed horizontal wood grain and subtle paint wear. The whole exposed wooden surface, behind the upper vegetables, behind the central lettering, and behind the lower vegetables, should read as ONE continuous pale creamy painted tabletop. A light warm ivory around #F8F0DC is the target: clearly cream rather than sage, fresh and bright, not yellow, tan, sepia, muddy or antique-stained. The fine grain can be softly beige; keep it delicate and low-contrast. Retain the softly lit natural shadows cast onto the wood.
Do not globally warm or recolour the image. Preserve the vegetables' original natural colours, existing detail, precise shapes and positions: red and orange tomatoes, purple onion, green peas above, orange carrots and purple-stemmed green kale below. Preserve ALL typography, spelling, size, letterforms, positioning, spacing and forest-green colour: "The Vegetable Guru", "Your at-a-glance" / "growing companion", "John Lennon". Keep the title leaf logo absent. Keep the existing yellow top-left ribbon with dark-green "100% Organic", the lower-right white tilted YouTube sticker and its red logo/green writing, and the lower-left black-and-gold Traditional Measurements badge, exactly in place and unchanged in appearance. The YouTube sticker remains neutral WHITE, distinct from the cream wood. All details stay crisp. No new elements, no panel borders, no additional grain/noise/mottling, no redesign or crop. This is solely a wood-paint colour variant of the same full-bleed portrait cover at the same 185:240 proportions.
